verdict.rationale: 2FAS supports data export (2FAS export files, backups, import/export in free tier) and imports from other apps, and vault recovery via Decryption Kit, plus self-hosting/local-first storage options — giving users a real path to take their data and leave. However, the export format is 2FAS's own encrypted backup file rather than a clearly documented open/standard format, and there's no evidence of bulk export to a universally interoperable format (e.g., standard OTP URI/CSV) or a documented data-portability policy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an open/standard export format (vs proprietary encrypted file), and independent confirmation that exported data is usable outside 2FAS without lock-in.
